name: Fetch API client (ESM)
content: export async function request<T>(url:string, init?:RequestInit){const res=await fetch(url,init);if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);return res.json() as Promise<T>}
description: Minimal fetch wrapper + typed JSON response helper.

name: Fetch client with AbortController
content: export async function request<T>(url:string, init:RequestInit={}){const ac=new AbortController();const t=setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),15000);try{const r=await fetch(url,{...init,signal:ac.signal});if(!r.ok)throw new Error(`${r.status}`);return r.json() as Promise<T>}finally{clearTimeout(t)}}
description: Adds request timeout via AbortController; used for mobile web.

description: Fetcher supports bearer token; hooks pass token from session.

name: Axios client with rate-limit backoff
content: api.interceptors.response.use(r=>r, async e=>{if(e?.response?.status!==429) throw e; const ra=Number(e.response.headers['retry-after']??1); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ra*1000)); return api.request(e.config)});
description: Retries 429 once using Retry-After; helps against burst limits.
